title: Capability Registry
description: Central directory where tools register contracts and heartbeats. Recorded facts — Mechanism: Capability Registry; Registry: central; Lookup: indexed query. Used by agent networks and service meshes so tools can find each other without hardcoding.
demo:
# Capability Registry — runnable demo (python3)
# Capability Registry - lookup latency estimate (python3)
entries=50000
ms_per_1k=2.0
budget=100.0
est=entries/1000.0*ms_per_1k
print("estimated lookup: %.1f ms for %d entries" % (est, entries))
print("WITHIN BUDGET" if est <= budget else "ADD INDEXING")
